thread:
amanda: Hey Boston folks — I'm visiting Wed night. Looking for casual dinner near Porter/Davis for 4, one vegetarian. Budget ~ $40/person. Any recs?
raj: Ooh, Little Gai (near Porter) has excellent dumplings and veg options. Small spot but super tasty :yum:
maria: If you prefer sit-down, Wayland Square Kitchen is solid — seasonal soups and bowls, really good for vegetarians.
leo: Clover Food Lab is fast-casual but reliably vegetarian. Cheap and quick if you're in a hurry.
jess: Sarma in Somerville is great for groups (lots of veg small plates) — 10–15 min Uber from Porter, a bit pricier but shareable.
amanda: Is Sarma walkable from Porter? I don't mind Lyft but prefer closer.
raj: It's a stretch to walk, probs 25–30m. For walking distance, Little Gai or Wayland Sq are better.
ops-bot: FYI company card policy reminder — meals under $50/person are pre-approved for team dinners. Check receipts for reimbursements.
maria: Quick map with pins: https://goo.gl/maps/example1 (Little Gai, Wayland Sq, Clover)
leo: Happy to reserve a table if we pick a place. Prefer somewhere with a true table for 4 (not just counter).
jess: I can call and hold a spot. Sarma might need a reservation; Little Gai often takes walk-ins.
amanda: Hmm — leaning Little Gai at 7pm to keep it simple and within budget. Anyone object?
jess: I'll call and try to get us on the list for 7. DM'ing Amanda for final headcount.
amanda: Awesome, thanks! See you Wed :party_parrot:
raj: Bring appetite :ramen:
ops-bot: Booking reminder: jess to confirm reservation (automated note at 1887654350).
